per_driver_disclosure_mapping.assumption_reason: The issuer does not print a per-vehicle price. It is derived by dividing the row's own revenue cell by the row's own volume cell. This is the weakest link of the mapping and is flagged for the reviewer: it must NOT be described as independently sourced net pricing.

「快报销量」is the full-year realised volume, so the annual exposure is already contained in units and the timing fraction must be exactly 1. Any value below 1 here would double-count time (card_M03.md line 40 forbids repeated time scaling).

NOT disclosed in the mapped table, so the field is left as missing rather than filled with an invented number. The documented default of 0.0 is used only to evaluate the synthetic positive case; it is NOT an authorisation to zero out undisclosed revenue (common_model_cards.md line 22).

mapping_1_result.warning: unit_revenue was derived from the same row's revenue, so this zero residual proves dimensional wiring only. It is NOT independent verification and NOT accuracy evidence (I-10-A item 3 forbids back-solving a parameter from revenue and then calling the same-formula result verification).

mapping_2_result.verdict: far outside the frozen 2% tolerance, and this is the INFORMATIVE result
mapping_2_result.interpretation: the automobile segment revenue cannot be rebuilt from vehicle volume x unit price; the difference is batteries, parts and other products that unit_sales cannot identify. Per card_M03.md line 40 and the I-10 production/sales/inventory bridge requirement, this difference must be bridged with real evidence and must never be booked as unexplained residual revenue.

unmapped_reasons: unit_revenue is DERIVED from the same disclosed revenue cell; an independent net-price source (price list, mix-weighted ASP disclosure, or a reconciled bridge) is still missing.
The gross/net and tax presentation of the 销售收入 column is not stated in the mapped table (special review SR-M03-B).
The production/shipment/confirmed-sales and channel-inventory bridge does not exist yet, so the 14.37% scope gap is unexplained.
No production forecast entry point was exercised or reviewed; D requires an independent reviewer's signature.
accuracy_reasons: F requires the I-12 frozen design; it does not exist.
The zero residual in mapping 1 is a constructive identity, so it cannot support any accuracy claim.
Formula qualification plus one company's mapping must never be escalated into industry-wide accuracy.
